title: About ani-gui
intro: ani-gui finds and plays anime on its own — Kitsu drives metadata, AniList feeds the home page's trending row, and aniskip marks OP/ED windows. Playback runs in the embedded hls.js player or hands off to an external one when you prefer.
donate_intro: If ani-gui has saved you time, a tip helps keep development going. Click the address to copy it, then paste into your wallet.
donate_copy_failed_toast: Couldn't access the clipboard — copy the address manually.
section_bundled_tools_hint: Shipped with the app, or installed alongside it
license_body: ani-gui is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. The full license text ships with each release.
bundled_tool_note_curl_impersonate: HTTP transport for source resolution. The provider turns away ordinary requests, so playback and downloads depend on it.
bundled_tool_note_yt_dlp: Download engine. Fetches the episode in parallel fragments and retries the ones that fail, so a flaky connection does not restart the whole file.
bundled_tool_note_ffmpeg: The Windows installer downloads it at install time and keeps it across updates; the .deb declares it as Recommends; AppImage relies on the system install. Used to mux downloaded segments into MP4.
bundled_tools_licenses: Each package installs the license texts of the tools it bundles, with the notices of the libraries built into them, under resources/licenses: in the install folder on Windows and for the .deb, inside the image for the AppImage.
install_download: The Windows installer downloads {name} {version}, as built by gyan.dev, while it installs; it is not part of the installer:
asset_note_lottie_loading: Drives the LoadingOverlay used during play resolution and similar waits.
